# Wikipedia

> > The free online encyclopedia that anyone can edit, containing millions of articles on every topic from history and science to culture and current events.

Wikipedia is a collaborative, multilingual encyclopedia founded by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger in 2001. The English Wikipedia is the largest edition, covering subjects ranging from mythology and astronomy to programming notation and historical events.

## Key Topics

- Collaborative editing
- Online encyclopedia
- Jimmy Wales
- Wikipedia history
- Featured content

- Date notation

## About Wikipedia

- [Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Main_Page): Wikipedia homepage featuring daily highlights and featured content
- [Wikipedia:About](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:About): About page describing Wikipedia and Wikimedia Foundation mission
- [English Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/English_Wikipedia): Overview of English Wikipedia edition by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger
- [History of Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_Wikipedia): Wikipedia's history from Nupedia origins to 2001 launch and growth
- [Wikipedia:Contents](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Contents): Site directory and table of contents for browsing Wikipedia subjects

## Featured Articles

- [Solar System](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solar_System): Comprehensive article on Sun, planets, and celestial bodies overview
- [Adamas (mythology)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adamas_(mythology)): Greek mythology article on Adamas, Trojan War character from Iliad

## Current Events & Reference

- [Portal:Current events/2026 March 13](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:Current_events/2026_March_13): Current events from March 13, 2026: Iran-Turkey-NATO conflicts
- [List of days of the year](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_days_of_the_year): Gregorian calendar reference index listing all days of the year

## Optional

- [//](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki///): Disambiguation page for double-slash notation in C, C++, Java, JavaScript
- [Wikipedia:Main Page/1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Main_Page/1): Alternative main page version featuring Swift Justice and Dick Wolf
- [10.5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/10.5): Disambiguation: NBC miniseries and Mac OS X Leopard version 10.5
- [7/8](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/7/8): Disambiguation for fraction, date notation, and Bulgarian 7/8 TV channel
- [4/7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/4/7): Disambiguation page for fraction and date notation 4/7
- [8/7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/8/7): Disambiguation for date notation and calendar dates 8/7
- [3/5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/3/5): Disambiguation: Three-fifths Compromise, USMC 3/5 battalion, Les Savy Fav
